jo: Ran into a weird duplicate in the onboarding sample when a 429 hits exactly during token rotation + immediate resend. Repro below.

jo: Repro: 1) open stream POST /v1/chat, 2) token expires mid-stream, 3) next frame gets 429, 4) SDK refreshes and immediately retransmits same frame, 5) server applies action twice.

ravi: thanks — do we attach any stable op id or replay nonce? sample uses per-frame IDs so retries look new.

jo: nope. Current stream envelope has frame_id that changes on retry. Also the SDK's refresh path uses a fixed 0ms pause then retry which seems to cause synchronized replays.

marie: two quick ideas: (A) preserve a stable operation id on the initial stream (header X-RW-Op or X-RW-Operation-Id) that server can dedupe for short TTL. (B) introduce a lightweight client-side replay handshake: before re-sending a frame after refresh, send a small HEAD/OPTIONS with a Replay-Nonce header; server replies "ok|seen". If seen -> skip resend. This avoids server-side dedupe state for long windows.

ravi: interesting. Replay-Nonce flow would add an extra round-trip but only when a refresh occurs. Could be opt-in and enabled in sampleapp for now.

jo: alternative less intrusive: add a default Idempotency-Key for mutating calls (opt-out) and change refresh-path to full jitter: sleep = rand(0, base * 2**attempt), base=150ms cap 10s. That should stop thundering replays.

marie: parity note: ensure node/python/java SDKs all expose a setOperationId() or accept operationId param when starting a stream. Also add a hook to enable Replay-Nonce behaviour for low-latency apps that prefer confirmation.

qa-bot: opened RW-8203: "devex: stream replay nonce + op-id + refresh-path jitter" assigned to @ravi. Attached minimal repro harness request.

ravi: I'll prototype two patches: 1) sampleapp add stable X-RW-Operation-Id and test harness that forces token expiry mid-stream (assert at-most-once), 2) SDK change: refresh path full jitter + optional replay-handshake flag.

jo: for server-side, we can keep a tiny LRU of seen operation ids for 30s and also support the replay-handshake endpoint. Document TTL and a max clamp so customers know limits.

marie: also suggest emitting a diagnostic response header when a duplicate is detected: X-RW-Replay: seen|accepted so clients can log without digging server traces. Make it opt-in behind a feature flag.

ravi: thanks, will post PR links. If anyone has objections to Replay-Nonce approach vs simple op-id dedupe, call it out now.

jo: no objections. prefer op-id + jitter as quick fix, handshake as an advanced option.

marie: action items: ravi - sampleapp PR + test harness, jo - onboarding doc note about Op-Id and Replay-Nonce, ravi - SDK PR for jitter + optional handshake. qa-bot will add the interop checklist.

ravi: will target canary tomorrow morning. ping me for pairing on interop tests. :mag:
